描述_EN: they must have had an important ritual function as they are often found in graves close to the bodies of the dead. they came in a variety of sizes and in two basic shapes. the production of jade rings and discs started in neolithic times in china and continued until the 19th century. earlier examples, like this one, are usually plain, with no carved patterns. the significance of these jade discs in neolithic times is not entirely clear. this type of jade ring with a small central hole is known as a ‘bi’. discs with a large central hole were known as ‘huan’.
描述_ZN: 它们一定有重要的仪式功能，因为它们经常被发现在靠近死者尸体的坟墓里。 它们有各种尺寸，有两种基本形状。 玉环和玉盘的生产开始于中国的新石器时代，一直持续到19世纪。 早期的例子，比如这个，通常是普通的，没有雕刻的图案。 这些玉盘在新石器时代的意义并不完全清楚。 这种中央有小孔的玉环被称为 "璧"。 中央有大孔的圆盘被称为 "环"。
